name: table
label: Table
description: Table name for the record's header

name: sysId
label: Sys ID
description: Sys ID for the record's header

name: isDocumentUploadDisabled
label: Is uploading Document disabled?
description: Select to prevent users from uploading documents

name: isReadOnly
label: Is form read only?
description: Select to make documents read only

name: recordDisplayValue
label: Record display value
description: The record display value to show in the upload overlay

name: overrideDeleteAction
label: Override delete action
description: Select to override delete action, user should handle delete/delinking of the document

name: overrideAddDocument
label: Override add document action
description: Select to override add document action, user should handle document linking to record or folder

name: refreshTimeStamp
label: Refresh Timestamp
description: Timestamp to trigger a refresh of the document list. When this property changes, the document list will be refreshed.

name: folderCustomActions
label: Folder Custom Actions
description: Array of custom actions to be displayed in the folder card dropdown menu. Each action should have a label, id, and optional icon.

name: documentCustomActions
label: Document Custom Actions
description: Array of custom actions to be displayed in the document card dropdown menu. Each action should have a label, id, and optional icon.

name: loadingState
label: Loading State
description: Loading state to show a loading overlay on top of the document list. Object with show (boolean) and message (string) properties.
